data.standardized_narrative: The report scanned contains detailed financial tables and notes for Syndicate 2357 for year ended 31 December 2016, but the scanned images provided do not allow a reliable extraction of the gross 'claims outstanding' opening balance (prior year comparative) or a definitive gross prior-year reserve movement. Gross written premium is visible in the financial summary (2016 gross written premiums reported as 175,106 in the native currency), however specific gross prior-year reserve movement figures, a movement note showing 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in gross terms, or an explicit gross claims development triangle could not be unambiguously read from the scanned pages provided. Accordingly no prior-year development amount or LOB-level reserve movements could be confidently extracted.
